rationale: Character event skins and administrator leave are JavaScript/UI/data-decoding changes. The two toothache bunny PNGs are imported by JavaScript and are not native icon/splash resources. The complete production native fingerprint exactly matches the published v1.0.2 APK runtime. Dependencies, lockfiles, Expo configuration, native modules/plugins, permissions, build hooks, app version and Android versionCode are unchanged. The operator notification CLI and post-publication release recorder were falsely rejected solely by the scripts path rule; only these two audited names were added to its existing administrative allowlist. Full native fingerprint equality and native-hook rejection remain mandatory. The verified master workflow now computes update and targets the installed production APK runtime.
evidence: Published stable APK v1.0.2 candidate.json identifies source 710bd2e10b4eb8aa16378486f3cb3517770ac878, version 1.0.2, Android versionCode 3, build d51d8be5-d5a1-4f8e-897e-71fd22381369 and runtime 4a7adc844a392bfaead47665719d0291b9f3da58. The baseline helper verified successful master Cloud Build run 40502268634; git confirms the APK commit belongs to origin/master.

Compared the complete APK-to-source file list and master-to-source changes, including previously released tabs/cache/timer work, event skins, admin leave, admin notifications, release automation, docs, Storybook and tests. Native/config input comparisons against the APK are empty.

package.json, package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, app.json, app.config.js, eas.json, config/, modules/, plugins/, native build hook scripts, .gitignore and .easignore are unchanged from v1.0.2. No version bump or fingerprint override was introduced by this release preparation.

src/design/skin-artwork.ts statically imports bunny-home-toothache.png and bunny-focus-toothache.png for JavaScript rendering in profile, home, friends and focus screens. Neither image is referenced by native app icon/splash configuration. Production web and Android Hermes exports include both images.

SDK-local runtimeversion:resolve reproduced the complete raw runtime 4a7adc844a392bfaead47665719d0291b9f3da58 before the classifier fix. After the fix, review-context independently reproduced the same normalized fingerprint with compatible=true, no exemptions and no unexplained differences.

scripts/admin-notifications.mjs is an explicit operator CLI using server authentication; scripts/update-release.mjs is called only after verified production OTA and web promotion. Neither is referenced by package install/prebuild/EAS hooks or application imports. The exact two names were added to the administrative script allowlist; unknown scripts and native input changes still reject OTA.

Regression tests exercise both audited names through six native hook types and confirm rejection; unknown scripts, native source, plugins, modules, eas.json, lockfiles and fingerprint configuration remain blocked. Existing source-digest, dependency/hook normalization, baseline and deterministic-route tests pass.

Reviewed check.yml, cloud-build.yml, publish-release.yml, publish-web.yml, eas.json, app.config.js, deployment.mjs, deployment-review.mjs, deployment-history.mjs, check-release.mjs and release-candidate.mjs. Current master already gates release PRs and production publication on exact review digest, published APK identity, computed route and verified exemptions.

Production master publication revalidates baseline/native compatibility and source, applies the existing guarded child-process runtime selection, and verifies EAS returned Android runtime and commit. Web preview uses the same source and is promoted only after verified Android OTA. Then update-release records v1.0.2-rN without changing GitHub Latest or triggering APK notices.
